item.title: Changelog: Grammar, Trying Momiji Without an Account, and Articles
item.description:
What changed in Momiji since the last post

The last post was about the first few minutes of using Momiji. Two things were still missing. You had to make an account before you could see anything, and Momiji had nothing for grammar. Words and kanji only get you so far: if you don’t know what ～てしまう or ～わけがない is doing, knowing every word in the sentence doesn’t help much. So this round was mostly grammar, plus letting people try Momiji before they sign up.

item.title: Changelog: A Friendlier Start, Better Reviews and a Browser Extension
item.description:
What changed in Momiji since the last post

The last post was about sentence decks and getting Momiji onto its own servers. Once that was done I looked at Momiji the way a new person would see it, and it wasn’t great. You logged in to an empty dashboard, kana was hidden behind a tab on the kanji page, and the sidebar used different names than the pages it linked to. So most of the last few days went into the first few minutes of using Momiji, and into making the reviews feel like one app instead of four.

item.title: Changelog: Sentence Decks, Recommendations, Analytics and Momiji Goes Live
item.description:
What changed in Momiji this week

After the last post I said I would focus on one feature at a time, finish it, and get Momiji somewhere I would actually want to use every day. This is what came out of the last week or so. Most of it is one big feature (sentence decks), but a lot of smaller things got finished along the way.

item.title: Defining and releasing a MVP
item.description:
I have started so many different features but have not really finished much to my likeing .

The dictionary does not have pagnation. The Anime Serires and deck pages are hard to navigate. Kana study is a copy of Kanji study and it does not quite fit. There seems to be quite a few things that are not really adding up to the product that I wanted to create and not to mention many things that are still just in my imagination.

item.title: Adding Prebuilt SRS Anime word Decks to Momiji
item.description:
Choose an anime episode or series to study and add the words to your study deck.

This feature is and has been taking almost a week to make due to technical challenges and my optimism that I can make it exactly like I want it to be. You can now select an anime episode or series to study and view the words that are in each episode ordered by the frequency that the appear in the episode. There are also now button to quick add the words to your study deck from either an episode or series.

item.title: Learning Jouyou Kanji, a little Analytics, backend updates
item.description:
A little bit of collapsible analytics and A Jouyou kanji deck build in

Also, mobile screens

I have spent a little bit of time working on the kanji Study feature trying to get it to the point where I can find it useful. For me that means at least a built-in study deck and some analytic. And that is what we have here…

item.title: A Simple Centralized SRS
item.description:
Creating Momiji’s SRS

Momiji now has the beginnings of a Anki compatible SRS that can take words directly from the dictionary and store them with your user data. The data is 100% exportable to Anki for offline study, I just have to get the formatting nice before I create that feature
